name: PayPal USD Main
oneLiner: senPYUSDmain is Sentora's PYUSD Morpho Vault V2 share; yield and losses change NAV, and cash redemption depends on idle PYUSD.
collateral: PYUSD lending positions against cbBTC, WBTC, LBTC, syrupUSDC, wstETH, weETH, sUSDe, kBTC. Allocations change under curator controls; borrower collateral is distinct from the underlying deposited token.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposit/mint and withdraw/redeem exchange shares for PYUSD at the current asset conversion rate. Lending interest, fees and realized losses change NAV. At Ethereum block 26197398 (2026-10-15), liquidityAdapter() is zero, so ordinary cash redemption uses idle PYUSD unless assets are first deallocated. Holder-initiated forceDeallocate through the current adapter calls Morpho.withdraw and charges a 0.01% penalty on assets deallocated; it still requires market cash liquidity. This exact adapter does not directly transfer lender positions to the holder. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum deployment 0xb576765fb15505433af24fee2c0325895c559fb2 is immutable VaultV2, issuing transferable ERC-4626 operational shares over PYUSD, not a direct fiat or parent-reserve ownership claim. At Ethereum block 26197398 (2026-10-15T10:44:47Z), asset() is PYUSD, decimals()=18, totalSupply()=197014583182103401408852592 and convertToAssets(10^18)=2024483 PYUSD base units. Vault and sole adapter runtime match their exact verified sources; all three EIP-1967 proxy slots are zero. The earlier one-share redemption simulation remains evidence at block 26107702 only; this refresh does not claim a new execution measurement. The protocol-position archetype intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent. Exact deployment creation transaction 0x15ff511e3936ae415ad809e4872aad8b195f13abc10a2e03e7cfa42b678a6d2b is at block 24025034, timestamp 2025-12-16T12:01:35Z.
